headline: President Clinton created a commission to study how the federal government budgets for long-term investments like buildings and equipment.
what_it_does: This order set up a commission to study capital budgeting, which means planning and paying for long-lasting assets separately from day-to-day spending. Based on the title, the commission's job was to study the topic and give advice. No source summary was provided, so details about members, duties, and deadlines are not covered here.

who_it_affects.how: They may have been asked for information and could later be affected by any changes the commission recommended.
